title: Experimental interfaces for the DELPHI flight/gliding protein panel, from deposited RCSB PDB structures
bird_exclusion: Class Aves is this project's frozen holdout; no bird structure was fetched and no bird species is named here, until the holdout exam runs.

method.search: RCSB Search API v2 (https://search.rcsb.org/rcsbsearch/v2/query): structured search on rcsb_polymer_entity_container_identifiers.reference_sequence_identifiers.database_accession for a known UniProt accession, plus contains_phrase search on rcsb_polymer_entity.pdbx_description for families where our own panel protein has no structure.
method.contacts: gemmi ContactSearch on the deposited mmCIF (asymmetric unit unless noted), heavy atoms only, hydrogens and waters removed, inter-chain pairs within 4.0 A; a residue pair is reported once with its minimum atom-atom distance and the number of atom pairs under the cutoff.
method.numbering: Contacts are first collected in author numbering, then converted to UniProt numbering through RCSB's own SIFTS-derived alignment (/core/uniprot/{entry}/{entity}, aligned_regions: uniprot_pos = ref_beg + label_seq - entity_beg) combined with the label_seq_id -> auth_seq_id table read out of the same coordinate file. Residues outside any aligned region (expression tags, engineered linkers, unmodelled loops) carry uniprot_pos = null and are kept, flagged.
